spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing. p-12 to p-24 for sections. Use Mode A: Tetris Grid for asymmetric layouts.

component_instructions.navigation: Crystal Glass sticky nav (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-[#DCD7C9]/40). Must have brand name, 4 links, and a primary CTA.
component_instructions.buttons: Rounded-full. Primary: bg-[#2B4C3B] text-white hover:bg-[#1E3629] transition-all. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#2B4C3B] text-[#2B4C3B] hover:bg-[#EFEBE1].
component_instructions.cards: Solid backgrounds (bg-[#F7F5F0]) with 1px border-[#DCD7C9], soft shadow on hover.
component_instructions.marquee: The 'Editorial Ribbon' - very slow, organic, pale background (#EFEBE1) with deep forest green text (#2B4C3B). Use Cormorant Garamond, wide tracking.

sections_blueprint.name: Navigation
sections_blueprint.description: Sticky top nav with glassy effect. Left: 'Aura OS', Center: 'Platform, Use Cases, Manifesto, Pricing', Right: 'Request Access'

sections_blueprint.name: Hero
sections_blueprint.description: Massive serif headline left-aligned: 'The first operating system for human emotion.' Body: 'Sensing affect, providing coaching, and mediating communication in the AI era.' Uses Tetris grid. Right side: Large organic abstract image (soft 3D shapes). Massive spacing py-32.

sections_blueprint.name: Partners/Social Proof
sections_blueprint.description: Subtle editorial ribbon of company logos or text like 'TRUSTED BY PIONEERS — INTEGRATES WITH YOUR TEAMS — MEDIATES CONFLICTS'. Very slow moving.

sections_blueprint.name: The Problem
sections_blueprint.description: Asymmetrical layout. Large quote/stat about the lack of EQ in AI. Calm portrait of a person in thought. Background: bg_secondary.

sections_blueprint.name: Product Modules
sections_blueprint.description: 3-4 bento grid cards explaining: 'Affect Sensing', 'Conflict Mediation', 'Growth Coaching'. Cards have soft rounded corners, earthy tones, subtle hover lifts.

sections_blueprint.name: Interactive Emotion Visual (Demo)
sections_blueprint.description: A central section demonstrating the 'Sensing' capability. Left: UI mockup of emotion sensing. Right: Explanatory text. Use glassmorphism delicately.

sections_blueprint.name: Use Cases
sections_blueprint.description: Personal, Teams, AI Agents. Switching between them changes the accompanying image and text.

sections_blueprint.name: Testimonials
sections_blueprint.description: Quotes from early adopters. Clean typography, large serif quotes.

sections_blueprint.name: Manifesto
sections_blueprint.description: Founder's note. Centered, max-w-2xl, beautifully typeset in Cormorant Garamond. Focus on 'Why EQ matters now'.

sections_blueprint.name: Pricing
sections_blueprint.description: 3 tiers: Personal, Team, Enterprise. High contrast on the middle tier using primary_accent background.

sections_blueprint.name: FAQ
sections_blueprint.description: Shadcn accordion customized with earthy borders and colors.

sections_blueprint.name: Waitlist/CTA
sections_blueprint.description: Massive CTA. Dark background (#2B4C3B), light text. 'Join the evolution of intelligence.' Input field + Button.

sections_blueprint.name: Footer
sections_blueprint.description: Large footer, massive space py-24. Large brand logo text at the bottom. Grid of links.

image_urls.description: Soft flowing abstract 3D shapes with warm neutral tone
Contemplative adult male in soft natural light
Close-up portrait of a woman in deep thought wearing headphones

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Lenis smooth scrolling is MANDATORY for a premium feel.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons should have a slight scale (0.98) on click, and color transition on hover.
motion_and_interactions.entrance_animations: Staggered fade-up for bento grid cards using framer-motion. Keep it subtle, duration 0.6s, ease out.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA guidelines. White text on primary_accent (#2B4C3B) is safe. text_primary (#1A1A1A) on backgrounds is safe.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Pure HTML/Tailwind for structural marketing sections to ensure asymmetry. Use customized Shadcn for interactive pieces (Accordion for FAQ, Input/Buttons for CTA, Tabs for Use cases). DO NOT use standard SaaS blue/purple gradients. Stick strictly to the Organic & Earthy palette. Use the provided images from image_urls, NO placeholders. Apply liberal padding (py-24, py-32) to sections. Set fonts globally in Tailwind config.
